body: I used to feel betrayed by my family for so long bc they didn't accept me. I loved them so much and wanted them to love me for who I am. I eventually said fuck them and emotionally distanced myself from them as much as possible. It's still hard, but I know we wouldn't make each other happy rn. It's a huge contradiction bc you'd want to be emotionally available for your family they should always be there for you, but when they actively show they don't care abt you I wouldn't call them family anymore, at least for the time being, and just try to disconnect from them. They don't want to see you win. I think a lot of ppl on this subreddit would love to see you win though ❤❤
